items.question: What ritual honors must the teacher perform for the inscribed tablet?
premises: The teacher performs worship using cloth and other offerings.
The act of worship is completed by the teacher as officiant.
The inscribed tablet must also receive ritual worship.
items.inference: Therefore the teacher must ritually honor the offerings and also worship the inscribed tablet.
uncertainties: The exact referent and material of patrikā in this ritual context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped with cloth and other offerings, the teacher should also worship the tablet.
